pure-announcement.rationale: It is persistent quickstart documentation, not a launch or release note, but it also carries no idea beyond literal SDK usage.

duplicate.rationale: The content is too shallow (install commands, API key setup, a self-hosting cloud-provider list) to substantively overlap with snapshot-backed-agent-sandboxes or request-level-sandbox-isolation; there is no real idea here to be a duplicate of.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The instructions are concrete and directly verifiable (install command, API call, self-hosting repo link), just not a durable idea.

durability.rationale: The note is entirely getting-started mechanics — package names, an API-key flow, a cloud-provider support list — and never actually reaches the session-to-sandbox routing architecture (control plane vs data plane) this hunt was looking for; it will date with the next SDK revision like any quickstart.

actionability.rationale: It tells a reader the literal commands to start a sandbox, which is not the same as giving a decision-relevant architectural pattern to build against.

atomicity.rationale: It is one coherent, if shallow, idea (how to install and start an E2B sandbox) rather than several bundled unrelated ideas.
